item.description: The Vermont Statehouse received its Christmas tree from the Delphas family of Rutland. The tree will be displayed as part of the holiday decorations. This marks the start of the festive season at the Statehouse.

Vermont released new school performance data to support district consolidation efforts. The State Board is reviewing merger standards and class-size rules to guide committees. Merger committees are resuming meetings to evaluate educational quality and sustainability.

Bromley Mountain Ski Resort has delayed its opening day to next weekend despite snowmaking efforts. Stratton Mountain and Bolton Valley have also postponed openings, with Bolton Valley aiming for December fifth. Jay Peak will open Friday with a special event for season passholders and guests.

The Vermont AI Economic Task Force is hosting public sessions this December to hear from Vermonters about artificial intelligence. Sessions include presentations and small-group discussions on AI's role in work and communities. The Castleton session is now Monday, December seventh, with online surveys open through that day.
